description: Biohacking Village at DEF CON 26 explores the intersection of biology, genetics, and security. The 11 talks cover medical device vulnerabilities, genetic engineering, DNA security, pacemakers, in utero genetic treatment, immune system exploitation, and the ethics of biohacking.
